description: Aérodromes de la Région Île-de-France inscrits au Sdrif approuvé le 27 décembre 2013 is a dataset listed in Plateforme open data de la Région Île-de-France, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by L'Institut Paris Region. [ Situation 2013 ] Cette donnée a notamment pour but de répondre à l'objectif de produire une information d'un niveau de précision adapté à une carte au 1/150000. Coverage: Île-de-France. The portal files it under Déplacements - transports, Aménagement du territoire. Its keywords are Transport aérien, Transport, SDRIF. The portal shows 27 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2021-02-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-iledefrance-fr-portal.
